sloka: इत्यहम् तस्य शापस्य भीतः प्रसभमेव ताम् ।नारोहये बलात्सीताम् वैदेहीम् शय्ने शुभे ॥६-१३-१५॥।।
transliteration: ityaham tasya śāpasya bhītaḥ prasabhameva tām ।nārohaye balātsītām vaidehīm śayne śubhe ॥6-13-15॥।।

translations.english: "Thus, frightened on account of his curse, I do not perforce to get her to my lustrous bed."
